description: Congestion difficulty schedule and chained work stamp (SIGE spec 5.5D). requiredDifficulty(policy, windowedUnseals) = dFloor * 2^clamp(windowedUnseals-baseline, 0, cap). chainedWork(prevOutput, leafHash, difficulty) = SHA256("SIGE-DEMO-UWC"||prevOutput||leafHash) hashed difficulty more times. Seed derivation (src/core/vectors.ts): prevOutputHex = seededBytes(prevOutputSeed, 32) and leafHashHex = seededBytes(leafHashSeed, 32), where seededBytes(label, length) concatenates SHA-256 blocks sha256(seedDomain + '/' + label + u32be(counter)) for counter = 0, 1, 2, ..., truncated to length bytes. Independently cross-checked: the difficulty schedule by hand (exact integer doubling); the chained-work output against node:crypto sha256 looped difficulty times.

vectors.description: difficulty escalates above baseline and saturates at cap
a chained work stamp verifies at its own difficulty and refuses a higher requirement
